targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS conversations FROM interaction_logs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, avg(latency_ms) AS avg_latency_ms FROM interaction_logs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE error IS NOT NULL) / GREATEST(count(*), 1) AS error_rate FROM interaction_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT sum(estimated_cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM interaction_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1) / GREATEST(count(*), 1) AS satisfaction_pct FROM user_feedback WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'

SELECT jsonb_array_elements(retrieved_context::jsonb) ->> 'product_name' AS product_name, count(*) AS times_searched FROM interaction_logs WHERE retrieved_context IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT jsonb_array_elements(tools_called::jsonb) ->> 'name' AS tool_name, count(*) AS calls FROM interaction_logs WHERE tools_called IS NOT NULL AND tools_called != '[]' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
